newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN HEADLINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors affecting Indian stock markets on Friday morning:

** The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) closed on account of the Hindu New Year. It will open briefly for an auspicious "moorat" session on Sunday to herald the New Year. The BSE is also closed on Monday and Tuesday
National Stock Exchange open on Friday and Monday, but closed on Tuesday and Wednesday

** India's first share depository, the National Securities Depository Ltd (NSDL) -- promoted by Unit Trust of India, the National Stock Exchange and the Industrial Development Bank of India -- will be launched by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram on Friday
The depository is set to introduce paperless trading expected to eliminate lengthy share transfer rules, cut transaction costs and boost foreign inflows, its chief told Reuters on Thursday

** Two officials of ITC, India's biggest cigarette company, arrested by a federal agency in a widening investigation of alleged violations of foreign exchange rules involving $100 million. The agency has already arrested two former ITC chairmen
** India's market regulator, the Securities & Exchange Board of India has instructed all the premier stock exchanges to fix a circuit breaker on the ITC scrip, the Business Standard reports
** The death toll from the cyclone that struck India's southeastern state of Andhra Pradesh has climbed over 500, Hyderabad police officials said on Friday
The cyclone struck the low lying coastal strip south of Kakinada port late on Wednesday devastating the small farming communities in the fertile rice growing region of the Godavari river delta
** The Indian rupee opened steady at 35.74/75 per dollar. The day's range seen at 35.71/75 rupees to a dollar
** Share prices at major Indian bourses recorded small gains on Thursday on short-covering by speculators ahead of a long holiday
** The 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange index rose 22.50 points to 3,066.66
** The 100-share National Index was up 8.05 points to 1,371.75
